output.answer: Tilray Brands (NASDAQ: TLRY) had short interest of 19,539,742 shares (about 19.54 million) as of October 30, 2026, equal to 13.44% of its public float. The short-interest ratio was 4.8 days to cover, and short interest was down 9.21% from the prior report.
caveats: Short interest is reported on a biweekly schedule and carries a reporting lag; this is not a real-time count of open short positions.

Nasdaq's directly opened TLRY short-interest page currently displays that data is unavailable, so the latest figure above is from MarketBeat's report of the October 30, 2026 settlement/record date. MarketBeat and AltIndex differ slightly on the denominator presentation (public float versus shares outstanding), so the percentages should not be treated as identical metrics.
